_meta.description: 200 body of PATCH /api/invites/{inviteId} (MYR-369), built from vehicle-sharing.schema.json's own printed examples. The contract states exactly what this body is: 'the updated ShareInvite (an accepted row, so it carries allowRides, suspended and the derived permission, and carries NEITHER code NOR shareUrl)'. Both absences are asserted rather than merely omitted here — a redeemed grant has no live code, and a body that carried one would be handing back a bearer credential the redemption spent. This row is the result of suspending a grant that may ride: allowRides stays TRUE because a partial update writes only the properties present, and suspension does not clear the capabilities it gates.
